title: Law to require an information toolkit for older adults
summary: This bill would require the Department for the Aging to create an informational toolkit on programs, benefits and services available to New Yorkers age 60 and older, including rent freeze and meal delivery programs. DFTA would have to distribute printed copies annually at older adult centers and to homebound seniors, post a digital version online, and update the toolkit regularly. The toolkit must be available in English and all designated citywide languages and include accessibility features.
